one_line: Open on a named parent fear in the first second, then answer it with the product in use.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 extreme close-up of a green squishy ball squeezed at the lens; subtitle "פוחדת". 0:01 a mother in a garden holds a squishy toy up. Said (transcript): "איך אני פוחדת מהסקוישי האלו?" A news screenshot inset at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: A specific fear that parents of squishy-loving children know, said and subtitled in the first second (H1, H6, K6). A face and voice join within 1.3 s (H4), and a squeezed object at the lens gives motion from frame one (E1).

beats.what: Squishy close-up, then the mother in a garden: worry about squishies; news inset at 0:03
beats.why: A fear with a news-style reason

beats.what: A green box of jelly blocks on a wooden floor, a child's hand
Indoors she stretches bead-filled and yellow blocks: "בלי לקבל התקף לב"
She and two girls build on the floor; subtitled skills: "קואורדינציה", "חקירה"
beats.why: Children at play carry the benefits

beats.what: "ולפני שתגידו שאני מנסה לדחוף לכם עוד משחק" over the play footage
beats.why: Answers the viewer's doubt out loud

beats.what: Girls carry and tip the box; "ליצור", "להתפתחות"
Two girls wave behind the closed box; "בקיצור ... לכם"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "רוצות לינק? כתבו לי בתגובות 💌" (comment for a link). The video ends on a closing recommendation, not a question.
q2_flow.why: Fear, then solution, then proof is a clean arc that holds a short Reel (K2, H5), and the 0:17 objection restarts attention mid-way (R3). Cuts about every 1.6 s keep the picture changing (E2). At 28 s it stops right after its last line (R1, E8).

q3_cta.what: In the video: only a closing recommendation, "בקיצור ... לכם" at 0:26 to 0:27. Caption, last line: "רוצות לינק? כתבו לי בתגובות 💌". No comment word, no price.
q3_cta.why: A comment ask that delivers a real link has a purpose (C2, C3), but it names no keyword and sits in the last caption line, with nothing said or shown at the end of the video (C6). It is one action only (C1).

q4_shown.what: A squishy and a news screenshot inset (0:03 to 0:05); the green box of jelly blocks at 0:05; she stretches and squeezes the blocks 0:06 to 0:12; two girls about 3 and 5 build on the floor 0:12 to 0:25; the girls wave behind the box. No brand, no price.
q4_shown.why: The fear comes before the product, so the blocks land as relief, told by a mother in her own words (S6). Stretching a block on camera checks the "won't burst" claim. The product first appears at 4.9 s and no brand is readable (S1, H3). Two children's faces are on camera (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 17 shots in 28 s (first pass), about 1.6 s each; jump cuts between garden, living room and floor. No speed changes seen. Subtitles change every 1 to 2 words, emoji above. A news inset for 2 s. Ends on the girls waving.
q5_edit.why: Fast cuts and a new word every second keep the Reel moving (E2, R3), and big word-by-word subtitles carry the message muted (E4, T1). The emoji and size crowd the picture and sit over the children's hands (T2, T4).

q6_topic.what: A mother's worry about squishy toys that burst, and a soft building-block set as the calmer alternative; it serves parents of children who love squishies.
q6_topic.why: A current safety worry is a real parent concern that ends in relief (K6, K1). The skills list is short and modest (K4), and the problem, turn and play payoff make a small story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone: a close selfie-style hook in a garden, a lavalier mic with a fur cover visible; indoors at eye level for the stretch; high-angle floor shots of two girls; a static wide shot at the end. Daylight, home.
q7_filmed.why: Direct address at arm's length, objects held to the lens and daylight at home read as a real mother (F6, H8, F7). The wide end shot makes the closed box small (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Large bold white word-by-word subtitles, 1 to 3 words, small emoji above, about 75% down the frame: 0:00 "פוחדת", 0:01 "הבנות", 0:04 "לחרדה", 0:07 "קוביות", 0:08 "נעימות", 0:11 "בלי לקבל התקף לב", 0:16 "חקירה", 0:26 "בקיצור", 0:27 "לכם". News inset top right 0:03 to 0:05, partly readable. No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "אם גם הילד שלכם מאוהב בסקוישים, אבל אתן מפחדות מאסון". About 52 words in short lines: the solution, a skills list with emoji, a personal line, the comment ask. No hashtags, no disclosure, no brand.
q8_text.why: Big short subtitles are easy to read and work muted (T1, T5), though they sit in the lower band over the children's hands (T4, T2). The caption opens with the same audience callout and names the product in plain words (T7), but has no hashtags and no disclosure (T8, S7).

weak_points: The product appears only at 0:05 with no readable brand; the safety comparison rests on an unchecked news screenshot; two children's faces on camera; subtitles with emoji low over the hands; collaboration not disclosed; the ask only in the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a one-line parent worry (late bedtime, a first day at gan) in a word-by-word subtitle, then show the book and flip through it, hands only.
not_verified: The product brand and price (no brand readable; a label at 0:26 is illegible); whether the news screenshot is real and its source; music (not established); the transcript mishears some words, so subtitles are quoted. Speech is read as direct-to-camera 0 to 12 s and voiceover over the floor footage. Cut count from the first pass. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
